description: This file defines functions, classes, and methods related to protocol types for a ConfUI (Configuration User Interface) system, including command conversions, message serialization, and utility functions.

classes.name: ConfUiMessage
classes.description: Base class for ConfUI messages, providing utility functions like IsUserInput.

classes.name: ConfUiAckMessage
classes.description: Represents an acknowledgment message in the ConfUI protocol, with methods for string conversion and sending.

classes.name: ConfUiCliResponseMessage
classes.description: Represents a CLI response message with serialization and sending capabilities.

classes.name: ConfUiStartMessage
classes.description: Represents a start message in the ConfUI protocol, including UI options serialization.

classes.name: ConfUiUserTouchMessage
classes.description: Represents a user touch event message.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Converts a ConfUiCmd to a debug string, optionally verbose.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a ConfUiCmd to a string.

methods.name: ToCmd
methods.description: Converts a uint32_t or string to a ConfUiCmd enum.

methods.name: ToUiOption
methods.description: Converts a string to an optional UIOption.

methods.name: ByteVecToString
methods.description: Converts a byte vector to a string.

methods.name: ConfUiMessage::IsUserInput
methods.description: Checks if the message is a user input event.

methods.name: ConfUiAckMessage::ToString
methods.description: Serializes an acknowledgment message to string.

methods.name: ConfUiAckMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment message over a file descriptor.

methods.name: ConfUiCliResponseMessage::ToString
methods.description: Serializes a CLI response message to string.

methods.name: ConfUiCliResponseMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends a CLI response message over a file descriptor.

methods.name: ConfUiStartMessage::UiOptsToString
methods.description: Serializes UI options to a comma-separated string.

methods.name: ConfUiStartMessage::ToString
methods.description: Serializes a start message to string.

methods.name: ConfUiStartMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends a start message over a file descriptor.

methods.name: ConfUiUserSelectionMessage::ToString
methods.description: Serializes a user selection message to string.

methods.name: ConfUiUserSelectionMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends a user selection message over a file descriptor.

methods.name: ConfUiUserTouchMessage::ToString
methods.description: Serializes a user touch event to string.

methods.name: ConfUiUserTouchMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends a user touch event over a file descriptor.
